author: TeIq
content:
**Scope.** design.md §9 threat model. Six primary threats listed; each gets at least one regression test that verifies the mitigation works. The M4 epic comment names these; this issue is the concrete test-suite deliverable.

**Deliverables.**
- `polaris-backend/tests/threats/` directory, one file per threat:
  - `t1_compromised_moderator.rs` — rate-limited action submission; anomaly detection on a moderator labeling N>threshold accounts in T seconds fires a "moderator behavior anomaly" event.
  - `t2_audit_tamper.rs` — flipping any byte in any `audit_log` row makes `xtask audit-verify` fail with a precise diagnostic (ties to #35).
  - `t3_weaponized_reports.rs` — N synthetic reports against an innocent subject from low-reputation reporters do not yield a high-confidence pattern observation (ties to G_REPORTER_REP above).
  - `t4_dos_report_flood.rs` — 1M identical reports get deduped to one incident with N reporters; CSAM-classifier hits never get dropped under load.
  - `t5_malicious_payload_render.rs` — reported content with `<script>` / `<iframe>` payloads renders behind a click-to-reveal warning; no auto-load of remote resources; sanitizing proxy strips image trackers.
  - `t6_moderator_identity_leak.rs` — a label emitted by Polaris carries the labeler key signature, never the moderator's id; the labeler-side `audit_log` retains moderator id but it is never exposed via any public API.
- `polaris-backend/tests/threats/common.rs` — shared fixtures.

**References.**
- design.md §9 (security & threat model) lines 1-6 for each threat.
- `.crosslink/rules/global.md` §Security — these tests are mandatory before declaring v1 done.

**Rust-quality.**
- Each test is hermetic — spins up its own Postgres/Redis via `testcontainers-rs`.
- No flaky timing-based assertions; use deterministic fakes for `tokio::time` where needed.
- Tests assert on *observable behavior* (HTTP responses, audit log content, emitted events), not implementation internals.

**Testing.**
- The suite itself is the deliverable; `cargo test --workspace --test threats` must be green.
- CI runs this suite on every PR.

**Done when.** All six threat tests pass; CI gate is in place; a deliberate regression in any mitigation fails the matching test loudly.
